name: Kangoku Joou ~Do S Onna Kanshu-tachi ni yoru M Otoko-ka Choukyou~
original_name: 監獄女王 ～ドS女看守達によるM男化調教～
source:
The protagonist, Taketo Murakami, is charged with assault and sent to prison.
But the place he's sent to is a government-approved correctional facility called ‘Femdom.’
It's a terrifying place that advocates ‘female supremacy’ and rehabilitates (trains) men under this ideology.
There, Taketo catches the attention of three female guards feared by all inmates.
A capricious and selfish young lady, a former soldier guard captain, and a warden who never stops smiling...
Under their relentless torture, his body and mind begin to change...

[Translated from [url=http://herencia.nexton-net.jp/product/prison_queen/story.html]the official website[/url]]
translation:
主人公村上武人因袭击罪被捕入狱。
但他被送往的地方，是政府认可的矫正设施“女性支配”。
这里提倡“女性至上”，在这种理念下改造（调教）男性。
在那里，武人引起了三名令所有囚犯畏惧的女看守的注意：任性自私的年轻小姐、曾是士兵的看守长，以及脸上永远挂着笑容的典狱长……
在她们无休止的折磨下，他的身心开始发生变化……

[译自[url=http://herencia.nexton-net.jp/product/prison_queen/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
